name: VC Dimension
definition: For a finite family $C\subseteq2^X$, $\dim_{\mathrm{VC}}(C)$ is the largest cardinality of a coordinate set $T\subseteq X$ whose trace $C|_T$ is all of $2^T$.
normalization: The empty coordinate set is shattered by every nonempty family, so every nonempty family has VC dimension at least zero.
comments: For partial cubes this is also called rank; it is invariant under coordinate permutations and independent bit complements.
